about: App builds in the stores' hands: under review, or live with players held on their store version. Each runs the game code inside it while the server changes with every deploy, so before a deploy changes the server, scripts/held-build-check.mjs builds each one marked check: true with the NEW migrations and runs tests/e2e/held-build.mjs on it; a crash stops the deploy. Add a build here when it's sent for review (commit = the Native apps run's commit); set check: false once no player or reviewer can have it any more.
